integrity: Exact Schubert/cohomology arithmetic reproduced by the included standard-library verifier. Topological and lattice-theory lemmas are reconstructed in the written proof and identified as general premises. No independent expert validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Theorem only for smooth transverse eight-hyperplane linear sections of \(\operatorname{Gr}(2,8)\), ordinary singular integral cohomology; no assertion that the ambient Schubert lattice exhausts algebraic codimension-two classes or that explicit representatives of the 630-dimensional complement are known. The Chern and rank-two pairing inputs were already published in 2016. Residual literature overlap risk remains.
title: Integral middle-cohomology lattice of the Grassmannian Calabi–Yau fourfold
